description: This file contains functions for automating browser interactions using Playwright, including actions like click, hover, drag, fill, evaluate, and batch execution of actions, with support for error handling and timeout management.

methods.name: resolveBoundedDelayMs
methods.description: Resolves a delay value ensuring it is within specified bounds.

methods.name: getRestoredPageForTarget
methods.description: Retrieves and restores the page state for a given target.

methods.name: resolveInteractionTimeoutMs
methods.description: Calculates a timeout value within a specified range.

methods.name: awaitEvalWithAbort
methods.description: Runs a promise with optional abort support, handling race conditions.

methods.name: executeSingleAction
methods.description: Executes a single browser action based on its type, with support for nested batch actions.

methods.name: batchViaPlaywright
methods.description: Executes a batch of browser actions with error handling and depth control.
